card.name: Long dash lines in tables and formulas
card.fires_on: Long runs of hyphens or em dashes used as a table rule or as a fraction bar in a formula. The mark is often a middle chunk of the line.

modes.label: Fraction bar in formula
modes.description: A dash line separating numerator from denominator in a clearance or dose calculation.

modes.label: Table header rule
modes.description: A hyphen line under column headings in a dosing or data table.
